name: web-agency-testimonial-locations-and-spray-footer-sections
title: Agency sections: tilted testimonial cards with a red centre card, office photo cards and a pink and red spray footer
whatItIs: A white page with 'Testimonials' and three tilted cards (pale blue, a large red centre card with a portrait tab, pale blue) with stars and quotes, 'Locations' with two tilted office photo cards with address captions, and a footer with a pink and red spray-paint texture, a large statement 'Shape the future with our agency' with inline images, pill links and social icons.
whatItMeans: Warm and lively; tilted cards and spray make testimonials feel human.
techniques: Tilt cards and give the hero card a strong colour.
Use spray-paint texture as a footer backdrop.
Embed small images inside the closing headline.

vocabulary.definition: A small photo tucked at the top of a card.
A white label over a photo giving a location.
A small picture inside a headline.
